characterizing the nutritional content embedded in social media content, and how this content is consumed and shared by the community.
understanding the nutritional content of food posts on Instagram and how the community reacts to them.
characterizing the nutritional content in social media posts and understanding how the community responds to healthy versus unhealthy food posts.

Instagram is used by the public to share food content, with healthy food content receiving the most community support.
Instagram users share a lot of healthy food content and the community supports such content the most.
Instagram is not a good platform for promoting healthy eating habits.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Instagram can be used as a platform for sharing food experiences and also as a platform for healthy eating.

the nutritional information of food can be extracted from social media and can be used to understand community behavior and preferences.
